voice.description: A royal alchemist, a man in his fifties: a smooth, low, velvety baritone voice, elegant and knowing, warm on the surface with a hint of something secret and poisonous underneath, precise diction, quietly amused, a scholar who always knows more than he says. He speaks English with a soft, neutral accent, close to the microphone in a quiet room, performing a character in a fantasy game.
